verses.original: Αὐτοὶ γὰρ οἴδατε ἀδελφοί τὴν εἴσοδον ἡμῶν τὴν πρὸς ὑμᾶς ὅτι οὐ κενὴ γέγονεν
verses.transliteration: Autoi gar oidate adelphoi tēn eisodon hēmōn tēn pros hymas hoti ou kenē gegonen
verses.literal: You yourselves know brothers that our visit to you was not in vain
verses.literalPt: PORQUE vós mesmos, irmãos, bem sabeis que a nossa entrada para convosco não foi vã;

verses.original: ἀλλὰ προπαθόντες καὶ ὑβρισθέντες καθὼς οἴδατε ἐν Φιλίπποις ἐπαρρησιασάμεθα ἐν τῷ Θεῷ ἡμῶν λαλῆσαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐν πολλῷ ἀγῶνι
verses.transliteration: alla propathontes kai hybristhentes kathōs oidate en Philippois eparrēsiasametha en tō Theō hēmōn lalēsai pros hymas to euangelion tou Theou en pollō agōni
verses.literal: As you are aware we had already endured suffering and shameful treatment in Philippi But in the face of strong opposition we were bold in our God to speak to you the gospel of God
verses.literalPt: Mas, mesmo depois de termos antes padecido, e sido agravados em Filipos, como sabeis, tornamo-nos ousados em nosso Deus, para vos falar o evangelho de Deus com grande combate.

verses.original: Ἡ γὰρ παράκλησις ἡμῶν οὐκ ἐκ πλάνης οὐδὲ ἐξ ἀκαθαρσίας οὐδὲ ἐν δόλῳ
verses.transliteration: Hē gar paraklēsis hēmōn ouk ek planēs oude ex akatharsias oude en dolō
verses.literal: For our appeal does not arise from deceit or ulterior motives or trickery
verses.literalPt: Porque a nossa exortação não foi com engano, nem com imundícia, nem com fraudulência;

verses.original: ἀλλὰ καθὼς δεδοκιμάσμεθα ὑπὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ πιστευθῆναι τὸ εὐαγγέλιον οὕτως λαλοῦμεν οὐχ ὡς ἀνθρώποις ἀρέσκοντες ἀλλὰ Θεῷ τῷ δοκιμάζοντι τὰς καρδίας ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: alla kathōs dedokimasmetha hypo tou Theou pisteuthēnai to euangelion houtōs laloumen ouch hōs anthrōpois areskontes alla Theō tō dokimazonti tas kardias hēmōn
verses.literal: Instead we speak as those approved by God to be entrusted with the gospel not in order to please men but God who examines our hearts
verses.literalPt: Mas, como fomos aprovados de Deus para que o evangelho nos fosse confiado, assim falamos, não como para agradar aos homens, mas a Deus, que prova os nossos corações.

verses.original: οὔτε γάρ ποτε ἐν λόγῳ κολακείας ἐγενήθημεν καθὼς οἴδατε οὔτε ἐν προφάσει πλεονεξίας Θεὸς μάρτυς
verses.transliteration: oute gar pote en logō kolakeias egenēthēmen kathōs oidate oute en prophasei pleonexias Theos martys
verses.literal: As you know we never used . . . words of flattery or any pretext for greed God is our witness
verses.literalPt: Porque, como bem sabeis, nunca usamos de palavras lisonjeiras, nem houve um pretexto de avareza; Deus é testemunha;

verses.original: οὔτε ζητοῦντες ἐξ ἀνθρώπων δόξαν οὔτε ἀφ’ ὑμῶν οὔτε ἀπ’ ἄλλων δυνάμενοι ἐν βάρει εἶναι ὡς Χριστοῦ ἀπόστολοι
verses.transliteration: oute zētountes ex anthrōpōn doxan oute aph’ hymōn oute ap’ allōn dynamenoi en barei einai hōs Christou apostoloi
verses.literal: Nor did we seek - praise from you or from anyone else although as apostles of Christ we had authority to demand it . . .
verses.literalPt: E não buscamos glória dos homens, nem de vós, nem de outros, ainda que podíamos, como apóstolos de Cristo, ser-vos pesados;

verses.original: Ἀλλὰ ἐγενήθημεν ἤπιοι ἐν μέσῳ ὑμῶν ὡς ἐὰν τροφὸς θάλπῃ τὰ ἑαυτῆς τέκνα
verses.transliteration: Alla egenēthēmen ēpioi en mesō hymōn hōs ean trophos thalpē ta heautēs tekna
verses.literal: On the contrary we were gentle among you like a nursing mother caring for her children
verses.literalPt: Antes fomos brandos entre vós, como a ama que cria seus filhos.

verses.original: οὕτως ὁμειρόμενοι ὑμῶν εὐδοκοῦμεν μεταδοῦναι ὑμῖν οὐ μόνον τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Θεοῦ ἀλλὰ καὶ τὰς ἑαυτῶν ψυχάς διότι ἀγαπητοὶ ἡμῖν ἐγενήθητε
verses.transliteration: houtōs homeiromenoi hymōn eudokoumen metadounai hymin ou monon to euangelion tou Theou alla kai tas heautōn psychas dioti agapētoi hēmin egenēthēte
verses.literal: We cared so deeply that we were delighted to share with you not only the gospel of God but our own lives as well That is how beloved you have become to us
verses.literalPt: Assim nós, sendo-vos tão afeiçoados, de boa vontade quiséramos comunicar-vos, não somente o evangelho de Deus, mas ainda as nossas próprias almas; porquanto nos éreis muito queridos.

verses.original: Μνημονεύετε γάρ ἀδελφοί τὸν κόπον ἡμῶν καὶ τὸν μόχθον νυκτὸς καὶ ἡμέρας ἐργαζόμενοι πρὸς τὸ μὴ ἐπιβαρῆσαί τινα ὑμῶν ἐκηρύξαμεν εἰς ὑμᾶς τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Mnēmoneuete gar adelphoi ton kopon hēmōn kai ton mochthon nyktos kai hēmeras ergazomenoi pros to mē epibarēsai tina hymōn ekēryxamen eis hymas to euangelion tou Theou
verses.literal: Surely you recall . . . brothers our labor and toil We worked night and day so that we would not be a burden to anyone while we proclaimed to you the gospel of God
verses.literalPt: Porque bem vos lembrais, irmãos, do nosso trabalho e fadiga; pois, trabalhando noite e dia, para não sermos pesados a nenhum de vós, vos pregamos o evangelho de Deus.

verses.original: ὑμεῖς μάρτυρες καὶ ὁ Θεός ὡς ὁσίως καὶ δικαίως καὶ ἀμέμπτως ὑμῖν τοῖς πιστεύουσιν ἐγενήθημεν
verses.transliteration: hymeis martyres kai ho Theos hōs hosiōs kai dikaiōs kai amemptōs hymin tois pisteuousin egenēthēmen
verses.literal: You are witnesses and so is God of how holy righteous and blameless our conduct was among you who believed
verses.literalPt: Vós e Deus sois testemunhas de quão santa, e justa, e irrepreensivelmente nos houvemos para convosco, os que crestes.

verses.original: καθάπερ οἴδατε ὡς ἕνα ἕκαστον ὑμῶν ὡς πατὴρ τέκνα ἑαυτοῦ
verses.transliteration: kathaper oidate hōs hena hekaston hymōn hōs patēr tekna heautou
verses.literal: For you know that we treated each of you as a father treats his own children
verses.literalPt: Assim como bem sabeis de que modo vos exortávamos e consolávamos, a cada um de vós, como o pai a seus filhos;

verses.original: παρακαλοῦντες ὑμᾶς καὶ παραμυθούμενοι καὶ μαρτυρόμενοι εἰς τὸ περιπατεῖν ὑμᾶς ἀξίως τοῦ Θεοῦ τοῦ καλοῦντος ὑμᾶς εἰς τὴν ἑαυτοῦ βασιλείαν καὶ δόξαν
verses.transliteration: parakalountes hymas kai paramythoumenoi kai martyromenoi eis to peripatein hymas axiōs tou Theou tou kalountos hymas eis tēn heautou basileian kai doxan
verses.literal: encouraging you comforting you and urging you to walk in a manner worthy of God who calls you into His own kingdom and glory
verses.literalPt: Para que vos conduzísseis dignamente para com Deus, que vos chama para o seu reino e glória.

verses.original: Καὶ διὰ τοῦτο καὶ ἡμεῖς εὐχαριστοῦμεν τῷ Θεῷ ἀδιαλείπτως ὅτι παραλαβόντες λόγον ἀκοῆς παρ’ ἡμῶν τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐδέξασθε οὐ λόγον ἀνθρώπων ἀλλὰ καθὼς ἀληθῶς ἐστὶν λόγον Θεοῦ ὃς καὶ ἐνεργεῖται ἐν ὑμῖν τοῖς πιστεύουσιν
verses.transliteration: Kai dia touto kai hēmeis eucharistoumen tō Theō adialeiptōs hoti paralabontes logon akoēs par’ hēmōn tou Theou edexasthe ou logon anthrōpōn alla kathōs alēthōs estin logon Theou hos kai energeitai en hymin tois pisteuousin
verses.literal: And . . . we continually thank God because when you received the word of God that you heard from us you accepted it not as the word of men but as it truly is . . . the word of God which is also now at work in you who believe
verses.literalPt: Por isso também damos, sem cessar, graças a Deus, pois, havendo recebido de nós a palavra da pregação de Deus, a recebestes, não como palavra de homens, mas (segundo é, na verdade), como palavra de Deus, a qual também opera em vós, os que crestes.

verses.original: Ὑμεῖς γὰρ μιμηταὶ ἐγενήθητε ἀδελφοί τῶν ἐκκλησιῶν τοῦ Θεοῦ τῶν οὐσῶν ἐν τῇ Ἰουδαίᾳ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ ὅτι τὰ αὐτὰ ἐπάθετε καὶ ὑμεῖς ὑπὸ τῶν ἰδίων συμφυλετῶν καθὼς καὶ αὐτοὶ ὑπὸ τῶν Ἰουδαίων
verses.transliteration: Hymeis gar mimētai egenēthēte adelphoi tōn ekklēsiōn tou Theou tōn ousōn en tē Ioudaia en Christō Iēsou hoti ta auta epathete kai hymeis hypo tōn idiōn symphyletōn kathōs kai autoi hypo tōn Ioudaiōn
verses.literal: For you brothers became imitators of the churches of God in Judea that are in Christ Jesus You suffered from your own countrymen the very things - they suffered from the Jews
verses.literalPt: Porque vós, irmãos, haveis sido feitos imitadores das igrejas de Deus que na Judéia estão em Jesus Cristo; porquanto também padecestes de vossos próprios concidadãos o mesmo que os judeus lhes fizeram a eles,

verses.original: τῶν καὶ τὸν Κύριον ἀποκτεινάντων Ἰησοῦν καὶ τοὺς προφήτας καὶ ἡμᾶς ἐκδιωξάντων καὶ Θεῷ μὴ ἀρεσκόντων καὶ πᾶσιν ἀνθρώποις ἐναντίων
verses.transliteration: tōn kai ton Kyrion apokteinantōn Iēsoun kai tous prophētas kai hēmas ekdiōxantōn kai Theō mē areskontōn kai pasin anthrōpois enantiōn
verses.literal: who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets and drove us out as well . . . They are displeasing to God and hostile to all men
verses.literalPt: Os quais também mataram o SENHOR Jesus e os seus próprios profetas, e nos têm perseguido; e não agradam a Deus, e são contrários a todos os homens,

verses.original: κωλυόντων ἡμᾶς τοῖς ἔθνεσιν λαλῆσαι ἵνα σωθῶσιν εἰς τὸ ἀναπληρῶσαι αὐτῶν τὰς ἁμαρτίας πάντοτε ἔφθασεν δὲ ἐπ’ αὐτοὺς ἡ ὀργὴ εἰς τέλος
verses.transliteration: kōlyontōn hēmas tois ethnesin lalēsai hina sōthōsin eis to anaplērōsai autōn tas hamartias pantote ephthasen de ep’ autous hē orgē eis telos
verses.literal: hindering us from telling the Gentiles how they may be saved As a result they continue to heap up their sins to full capacity the utmost wrath has come upon them
verses.literalPt: E nos impedem de pregar aos gentios as palavras da salvação, a fim de encherem sempre a medida de seus pecados; mas a ira de Deus caiu sobre eles até ao fim.

verses.original: Ἡμεῖς δέ ἀδελφοί ἀπορφανισθέντες ἀφ’ ὑμῶν πρὸς καιρὸν ὥρας προσώπῳ οὐ καρδίᾳ περισσοτέρως ἐσπουδάσαμεν τὸ πρόσωπον ὑμῶν ἰδεῖν ἐν πολλῇ ἐπιθυμίᾳ
verses.transliteration: Hēmeis de adelphoi aporphanisthentes aph’ hymōn pros kairon hōras prosōpō ou kardia perissoterōs espoudasamen to prosōpon hymōn idein en pollē epithymia
verses.literal: Brothers although we were torn away from you for a short time . . . (in person not in heart) our desire to see you face to face was even more intense
verses.literalPt: Nós, porém, irmãos, sendo privados de vós por um momento de tempo, de vista, mas não do coração, tanto mais procuramos com grande desejo ver o vosso rosto;

verses.original: διότι ἠθελήσαμεν ἐλθεῖν πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἐγὼ μὲν Παῦλος καὶ ἅπαξ καὶ δίς καὶ ἐνέκοψεν ἡμᾶς ὁ Σατανᾶς
verses.transliteration: dioti ēthelēsamen elthein pros hymas egō men Paulos kai hapax kai dis kai enekopsen hēmas ho Satanas
verses.literal: For we wanted to come to you indeed I Paul tried again and again but Satan obstructed us
verses.literalPt: Por isso bem quisemos uma e outra vez ir ter convosco, pelo menos eu, Paulo, mas Satanás no-lo impediu.

verses.original: τίς γὰρ ἡμῶν ἐλπὶς ἢ χαρὰ ἢ στέφανος καυχήσεως ἢ οὐχὶ καὶ ὑμεῖς ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ ἐν τῇ αὐτοῦ παρουσίᾳ
verses.transliteration: tis gar hēmōn elpis ē chara ē stephanos kauchēseōs ē ouchi kai hymeis emprosthen tou Kyriou hēmōn Iēsou en tē autou parousia
verses.literal: After all who is our hope our joy our crown of boasting if it is not you yourselves in the presence of our Lord Jesus at His coming
verses.literalPt: Porque, qual é a nossa esperança, ou gozo, ou coroa de glória? Porventura não o sois vós também diante de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo em sua vinda?

verses.original: ὑμεῖς γάρ ἐστε ἡ δόξα ἡμῶν καὶ ἡ χαρά
verses.transliteration: hymeis gar este hē doxa hēmōn kai hē chara
verses.literal: You are indeed our glory and our joy
verses.literalPt: Na verdade vós sois a nossa glória e gozo.
